answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 1560 Country: India Title: My brother wants to work in TV. i want to know if it is lawful to him to work as an employee in TV. What kinds of steps should he take to work in the Islamic TV or any other TV channel? Question: My brother wants to work in TV. i want to know if it is lawful to him to work as an employee in TV. What kinds of steps should he take to work in the Islamic TV or any other TV channel? Answer ID: 1560 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 492/484=D) (1) TV is a tool of amusement, the programme which are presented on TV are mostly containing indecent and obscene materials; therefore it is not right for your brother to work in the same. He should try to look any other source of income. (2) What do you mean by Islamic channel? What types of programme are presented over there? Please, explain in detail then we will a say in the matter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
